description: This header file defines interfaces and classes related to an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) service framework, including classes for managing IPC services, proxies for container management, and event handling related to container states.

classes.name: IIpcService
classes.description: Interface for IPC service operations such as validation, availability, flushing, starting, stopping, and retrieving bus address.

classes.name: IpcService
classes.description: Implementation of IIpcService, managing IPC connection details and state.

classes.name: IDobbyProxyEvents
classes.description: Interface for handling container proxy events such as state changes.

classes.name: IDobbyProxy
classes.description: Interface for container management operations via a proxy, including container lifecycle and information retrieval.

classes.name: DobbyProxy
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IDobbyProxy, providing methods to manage containers via IPC.

methods.name: createIpcService
methods.description: Factory function to create an IPC service instance with specified address and service name.

methods.name: IpcService
methods.description: Constructor and class methods to manage IPC service lifecycle.

methods.name: DobbyProxy
methods.description: Constructor and methods to control containers and interact with the IPC service.
